craft_notes: Sthāyin: thought-stopper (supportless mind = thoughts-not-to-be-thought — the double negative returns). Rows: row 3 (in-self→Bhairava deer-eyed). Close: deer-eyed (vocative — the address that makes the claim personal: Bhairava INSIDE, addressed). Rejected: 'suppress thoughts' — killed: not-to-be-thought kept (vikalpān na vikalpayet = no thinking of thoughts, not stopping); 'mindfulness' — killed: supportless kept (ni-āśraya is the OPPOSITE of support).

lines: Supportless mind made — thoughts not to be thought:
l4.sanskrit_cite: nirādhāraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā vikalpān na vikalpayet | tadātmaparamātmatve bhairavo mṛgalocane

reads_against.argmap: What happens to thoughts? → Supportless mind cancels thinking — Bhairava stands in self-supreme-self.
c1_essence: Supportless mind: thoughts not thought, Bhairava in self.
